name: TCL 58S571F Fire TV
summary: TCL 58S571F Fire TV ships with ads, content recognition and telemetry. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and one-tap undo.
intro: This TCL Fire TV runs Fire OS 8 and ships with Shop on Fire TV, content recognition that sees what is on screen including HDMI, sponsored rows, autoplaying previews and an advertising ID. It also uploads Wi-Fi and performance metrics and device logs, and carries extras such as an operator app, Luna, News, Gallery and a system status monitor.

Fire TV keeps Amazon's home screen, so this is a clean-up only. The list was lived with for several reboots, and Netflix, YouTube, Spotify, Stremio, AirPlay from an iPhone and a Mac, and Settings all worked. TidyTV saves a backup first and never deletes anything.
keep: Amazon's home screen, which also owns Settings
The Silk browser and Quick Settings
notes: Alexa voice comes back at every boot, so the list does not include it.
Two Amazon services are protected, and one telemetry emitter keeps running even when turned off.

faq.q: Will the voice button still work on my TCL 58S571F?
faq.a: Yes. Alexa voice stays on this list, and it turns itself back on at every boot.
Yes. AirPlay and Miracast are kept and were tested.

faq.q: Will it stop the ads on the home screen?
faq.a: It turns off sponsored and recommendation rows, autoplaying previews and the advertising ID. Amazon's home screen itself stays.
